Found it in the pinned brotli corpus. `BROTLI_MAX_SIMD_QUALITY` is defined in `c/common/platform.h:665` and `:668` (the only two definitions in the tree, under the two `BROTLI_TZCNT64` architecture branches), and in both it is `7` — "The SIMD matchers are only faster at certain quality levels." Its consumers confirm the semantics: `ShouldUseSimdHasher` (`c/enc/quality.h:169`) uses it as the quality ceiling when `BROTLI_SIMD_HASHER_ENABLE` is set, matching the public enum's comment "Use SIMD hasher when supported up to quality 7" (`c/include/brotli/encode.h:76`).

ANSWER: 7
